notice: FICTIONAL EXAMPLE DATA. Gravel Bay Ferry Authority is invented. These are the schema fields the pack matches against glossary.csv.
no_row_expects_REJECT_and_here_is_why: REJECT is unreachable for a rank-1 match in the shipped configuration. final_confidence has a structural floor of semantic_weight * fusion_alpha = 0.70 * 0.90 = 0.63, and review_threshold is 0.50. No top match can fall below the floor, so no top match can be rejected. The two novel fields below therefore expect REVIEW. Measured on this pack: rank-1 confidence ranged 0.8058 to 0.8958 over all 26 fields. See README.md, 'The finding this pack exists to show'.

expectation_keys.expected_id: the glossary id the top-ranked match must carry, or null when NO glossary term is a correct answer for this field. When it is null the pack asserts only that the field was not auto-approved -- which entry the matcher happened to rank first is recorded, not required.
expectation_keys.expected_decision: the MatchDecision the top-ranked match must carry under the shipped configuration: AUTO_APPROVE, REVIEW or REJECT
expectation_keys.why: why this field is in the pack; the interesting rows say what would go wrong if the expectation moved
expectation_keys.observed: for the rows that do not have a right answer: what the shipped configuration actually ranked first, recorded so the trap is visible

fields.doc: Full legal name of the passenger as printed on the sailing manifest.
fields.why: the clean case: a direct identifier that should inherit SEALED_RESTRICTED

fields.doc: Date of birth the passenger supplied when booking.
Email address used to send sailing notices to the passenger.
Mobile telephone number for disruption alerts.
Residential postal address held against the passenger account.
Vault token standing in for the payment card used to buy the fare.
Last four digits of the payment card, kept so a receipt can be found.
Bank account number a cancelled fare is refunded into.
Permanent staff identifier for a member of the vessel crew.
Maritime competency certificate number held by the crew member.
Sailing and watch the crew member is rostered to work.
Serial printed on the boarding pass, unique to one passenger sailing.
Six character reference identifying the booking across the estate.
Moment the boarding pass was scanned at the terminal gate.
Reference of the insurance claim raised after an incident at sea.
Amount the assessor put on the salvage claim.
Negotiated rate paid for a berth at a partner harbour.
fields.why: clean case: commercially sensitive but carries no personal information

fields.doc: Date the commercial harbour agreement lapses unless renewed.
Engine temperature reported on the vessel telemetry feed in celsius.
fields.why: clean case: operational data, the CREW_ONLY tier

fields.doc: Percentage of usable fuel remaining in the vessel tanks.
Departure time published in the sailing timetable.
fields.why: clean case: the most open tier

fields.doc: Public name of the ferry terminal.
Short code identifying the scheduled route between two terminals.
fields.why: the UNCLASSIFIED case: the glossary entry carries no protection class, so the field inherits the open tier and no PI flags

fields.doc: Salted digest of the passenger legal name, used to join bookings without holding the name itself.
fields.why: NEAR MISS. The top candidate is the full identifier, at 0.8292. Inheriting it would tag a pseudonymous digest as a direct identifier at SEALED_RESTRICTED, which is the costly direction: over-inheriting governance stops a lawful use of the data and is invisible until someone audits it. The field is not auto-approved, so a human decides.

fields.doc: Date the next inspection of a lifejacket locker falls due.
fields.why: NOVEL. Nothing in this glossary governs locker inspections, so the field must inherit nothing. Read the decision, never the score: this field's top match scores 0.8792, HIGHER than the near-miss above and higher than eight fields that are correct. What kept it out of AUTO_APPROVE was min_confidence_gap, not confidence -- its margin over the runner-up was 0.0384 against a required 0.10.
fields.observed: ranks GBF-0002 (Passenger Date Of Birth) first -- a date field pulling a SEALED_RESTRICTED direct identifier. Auto-approving it would have tagged a maintenance date as passenger identity.

fields.doc: Number of units of a galley stock line to reorder at the next resupply.
fields.why: NOVEL. Nothing in this glossary governs galley stock. Same shape as the row above: confidence 0.8058, margin 0.0362.
fields.observed: ranks GBF-0030 (Vessel Passenger Capacity) first -- the nearest 'a count of things' term in the glossary.
